parts.label: (b)
hints: Hint 1: Recall the energy band model of a semiconductor, including the valence band, band gap, and conduction band.
Hint 2: Explain how incident photons with energy greater than the band gap give energy to electrons in the valence band.
Hint 3: Describe the excitation of electrons into the conduction band, leaving holes in the valence band.
Hint 4: Explain that these electrons and holes act as mobile charge carriers, so higher light intensity increases carrier concentration.
Hint 5: Connect the increased charge carrier density and larger current to the decrease in electrical resistance of the LDR.
parts.proper_answer: photons of light give energy to electrons in valence band; electrons move into the conduction band; leaving holes in the valence band; these electrons and holes are charge carriers; increased number/increased current, hence reduced resistance
